title: Why Everyone Is Talking About Data Centers In Space
summary: Scott Manley examines why SpaceX, Google and others are looking at orbital data centers. He walks through the economics, heat rejection and solar power arguments, with links to the Lumen/Starcloud and Google Suncatcher papers.
why: Pointed to as a credible, engineering-informed answer to whether space data centers are feasible, from someone with deep space knowledge.

quote.text: Scott Manley had a really good video on it
